name: migrate_pages
synopsis: long migrate_pages(int pid, unsigned long maxnode, const unsigned long *old_nodes, const unsigned long *new_nodes);
description: migrate_pages() attempts to move all pages of the specified process from memory nodes in old_nodes to nodes in new_nodes. Pages not in old_nodes are not migrated, and the kernel tries to maintain their relative topology. It requires appropriate privileges for other processes.

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: ID of the process whose pages to move; 0 for the calling process.

parameters.name: maxnode
parameters.description: Maximum node number in the bit mask plus one.

parameters.name: old_nodes
parameters.description: Pointer to a bit mask of old node numbers.

parameters.name: new_nodes
parameters.description: Pointer to a bit mask of new node numbers.

return_value.success: Returns the number of pages that could not be moved; 0 means all were moved.
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and sets errno to indicate the error.

errors.description: Part or all of the memory range specified by old_nodes, new_nodes, and maxnode points outside the accessible address space.
maxnode exceeds a kernel-imposed limit, or invalid node IDs are specified, or no valid target nodes.
Insufficient privilege to move pages or access target nodes.
No process with the specified pid found.
